name: Choose The Context
description: A run starts grounded in the cards the request concerns.
purpose: Gives the planner the right material at little cost, so a run starts grounded in the person's own knowledge without re-discovering it.
approach: Composes the lane's context assembler, the resolver that follows a card's pointer to current text, the one ranking over cards and specification records, and the meaning index, each handed in as a seat and built on first use; a request that brings source groups is handed to digest-records-for-a-need.
out_of_scope: Reading a large body of records for one need (digest-records-for-a-need), keeping and refreshing the cards themselves (Subconscious), ranking which cards a request needs (context-retriever does that), and acting on what was chosen.
milestones: 1. The area arm per_lane_assembly hands each line to the member that owns it, with no change to what the lane's assembler returns.
knowledge: The area existed as four solutions the library reached through the lane's configuration; the specification owner asked (2026-11-04) that it be a top-level solution built the way the other areas are, so the hierarchy matches the code.
measures_of_success: The context chosen for a request is the material it concerns; a reference resolves to current text; nothing is added before the reply.
parameters: Which assembler the lane runs and how its stores are built, set by the lane's configuration.
inputs: A request's text and the lane's stores.
outputs: The assembled context, the ids of the cards it drew on, a resolved reference, a ranked list of cards and records, or the cards nearest a query by meaning.

name: Digest Records For A Need
description: A need over a large body of the person's records reaches the planner as a few cited findings.
purpose: Lets a step that needs something from hundreds of records read all of them without a prompt that holds them, so cost and prompt size stay bounded and every finding can be traced to a record the person can open.
approach: One cheap-tier sub-analysis per window of one source group returns the findings that bear on the need with the ids they rest on; an id not in the window is dropped in code; the reduce step is code; digests are cached under the need, the background and the window's content.
out_of_scope: Choosing which cards a request reads (choose-the-context), ranking cards (context-retriever), building the source groups (the host that owns the records), and any claim a record does not support.
milestones: 1. The selected arm digest_by_need passes the offline cases (citations exact, caps held, second read free, a failed group reported). 2. One real body digested by a real cheap model and hand-read, run only by decision under the metric run policy.
knowledge: It began (2026-11-09) as an arm of choose-the-context that a host had to pin by name, which showed its purpose differs from the arms beside it (those pick cards, this reads records for a need); it is a nested Subconscious solution so the host calls one line and the selected arm answers.
measures_of_success: The ids cited are the ones the need rests on, no prompt passes its cap, an unchanged group costs nothing the second time, and a group that cannot be read is reported without failing the call.
parameters: Window, record and finding sizes, the number of sub-analyses per call and the concurrency, each overridable by name in meta.
inputs: The need as text and, in meta, the source groups, the background and any cap.
outputs: The cited findings, the ids they rest on with their titles, and the status of every group.
effects: Model calls on the fast tier only for groups not already cached; reads only otherwise.
usage_notes: Selected today: digest_by_need. Reached with quest_ai_runner.run('digest-records-for-a-need', ...); a model caller is provided by the host.
